title: Why is Infinity Secure for International Payments?
summary: Learn how Infinity protects payment information, processes international transfers, and supports Indian exporters with FIRA and transparent pricing.
body_markdown:
## **What Security Measures Does Infinity Use?**


Infinity uses security measures designed to protect account and payment information and support the review of transaction activity. These include encryption, identity and document verification, access controls, and transaction monitoring.


### **1. Encryption and Data Protection**


Infinity uses AES-256 encryption and encryption at rest to protect information in transit and at rest. These safeguards help protect sensitive business information, account details, and payment records.


### **2. Identity and Document Verification**


Infinity verifies identity and documents to help confirm who is using the service and support relevant checks. Exporters may need to provide business or payment documents, depending on the account or transaction.


In case Infinity requests additional information, provide accurate details and give quick responses to help avoid delays.


### **3. Transaction Monitoring and Access Controls**


Infinity monitors transactions for activity that may need further review. Access controls help limit account and information access to authorised users.


Together, these measures help reduce risks involving suspicious activity and unauthorised access. They do not guarantee that every fraud attempt or payment issue will be prevented.


## **Can Exporters Get FIRA Through Infinity?**


A[Foreign Inward Remittance Advice (FIRA)](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/what-is-fira-its-importance-for-freelancers-in-india) records a foreign inward remittance. Exporters may need remittance records for accounting, reconciliation, or relevant compliance processes.


Infinity provides FIRA for eligible settled payments without an additional fee to the client. The document helps maintain a record of the inward payment and is available through the platform when generated for the transaction.


FIRA is a remittance record, but the documents required for a particular export or compliance process can vary. Exporters should check whether the available record meets the requirements of their bank, accountant, or authorised dealer.


## **How Does Infinity Help With Purpose Codes?**


A purpose code identifies the reason for receiving an international payment. The appropriate code depends on the transaction, including whether the payment relates to goods or services.


Infinity’s[purpose-code tool](https://tools.infinityapp.in/purpose-code) helps identify a relevant code for an inward remittance. The selected code should accurately describe the transaction and follow the instructions of the bank or authorised dealer handling the payment.


## **What are Infinity’s Fees and FX Markups?**


Infinity’s standard international bank-payment service has a[0.5% fee inclusive of GST](https://www.infinityapp.in/international-payments) and zero FX markup. Zero FX markup means Infinity does not add its own markup to the exchange rate for that service.


The final amount received may still be affected by the exchange rate applied and charges from the sender’s bank or intermediary institutions. Other Infinity products, such as card payments through QuickLinks, may have different pricing.


## **How Long Does Infinity Take to Settle International Payments?**


Infinity generally settles eligible international payments within one business day. However, the time from payment initiation to INR credit can vary by payment route, banking hours, verification, and any additional documentation requirements.


Exporters should check their payment status and expected settlement time. This helps them plan cash flow and match incoming payments with the relevant invoices.


## **Is Infinity the Right Payment Platform for an Export Business?**


Infinity may suit exporters looking for international payment services with a 0.5% standard bank-payment fee, zero FX markup, FIRA access for eligible settled payments, and a clear payment process.


The right service depends on the exporter’s needs. Before choosing a service, consider:

## **Frequently Asked Questions About Infinity**


### **1. What should I check before receiving my first international payment through Infinity?**


Complete your account verification and share the correct receiving details with your client. Confirm the invoice currency and select the appropriate purpose code. Follow any additional instructions from Infinity or your banking partner.


### **2. What should I do if my payment is delayed or I receive a different amount?**


Always check the payment status, expected settlement time, and any sender or intermediary bank charges that may affect your received amount. If the payment is overdue or the amount differs from your records, send an email to Infinity support atsupport@infinityapp.in with the transfer details. Avoid asking your client to send the payment again until the original transfer has been traced.


### **3. Do receiving details vary by currency or payment route?**


They may vary by currency and payment route. Before your client initiates a transfer, check the receiving instructions shown in your Infinity account and share the details for that specific payment.


### **4. Why hasn't my payment arrived even though my client says it has been sent?**


A payment marked as sent may still be processing through the banking system. Check its status and expected settlement time. If the funds do not arrive within the expected timeframe, contact Infinity support with the payment reference and transfer details.
